evidence.quote: A transfer case is a part of the drivetrain of four - wheel - drive , all - wheel - drive , and other multiple powered axle vehicles
The transfer case transfers power from the transmission to the front and rear axles by means of drive shafts
It also synchronizes the difference between the rotation of the front and rear wheels
and may contain one or more sets of low range gears for off - road use
